title.zh: Meta希望你的下一款设备融入Muse
title.en: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused

current_state.zh: Meta已开源Muse Gadgets SDK（ESP32和Linux，Apache 2.0），并推出Muse Home Link硬件集线器，供开发者构建Muse连接设备。
current_state.en: Meta has open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK (ESP32 and Linux, Apache 2.0) and launched the Muse Home Link hardware hub, enabling developers to build Muse-connected devices.

updates.title_zh: Meta希望你的下一款设备融入Muse
updates.title_en: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta正在开源Muse的代码，让开发者能将这一AI嵌入自家的消费设备，从电视到家电。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta is open-sourcing the code for Muse so developers can embed the AI into their own consumer devices, from TVs to appliances.

updates.current_state_en: Meta is open-sourcing the code for Muse so developers can embed the AI into their own consumer devices, from TVs to appliances.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta is open-sourcing the code for Muse so developers can embed the AI into their own consumer devices, from TVs to appliances.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta is open-sourcing the code for Muse so developers can embed the AI into their own consumer devices, from TVs to appliances.

updates.title_zh: Meta开放Muse硬件SDK：ESP32、树莓派都能接入
updates.title_en: Meta开放Muse硬件SDK：ESP32、树莓派都能接入
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta开源了Muse Gadgets SDK，包括ESP32固件和Linux SDK（Apache 2.0协议），并推出Muse Home Link USB-C集线器（首批5000台，美国Muse订阅用户免费，10月发货）以连接智能家居设备。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK, including ESP32 firmware and a Linux SDK under Apache 2.0, and launched the Muse Home Link USB-C hub (5,000 units, free for US Muse subscribers, shipping in October) to connect smart-home devices.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta已开源Muse Gadgets SDK（ESP32和Linux，Apache 2.0），并推出Muse Home Link硬件集线器，供开发者构建Muse连接设备。
updates.current_state_en: Meta has open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK (ESP32 and Linux, Apache 2.0) and launched the Muse Home Link hardware hub, enabling developers to build Muse-connected devices.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK — ESP32 firmware and a Linux SDK under Apache 2.0 — so developers can build their own Muse-connected hardware, alongside a new Muse Home Link USB-C hub (5,000 units, free for US Muse subscribers, shipping in October) that bridges Muse into home networks for controlling smart-home devices.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK — ESP32 firmware and a Linux SDK under Apache 2.0 — so developers can build their own Muse-connected hardware, alongside a new Muse Home Link USB-C hub (5,000 units, free for US Muse subscribers, shipping in October) that bridges Muse into home networks for controlling smart-home devices.
